change: ShardedHybrid publishes every region, records.recs and a versioned manifest inside an immutable sharded-generation-NNN directory before one fsynced CURRENT rename makes the snapshot authoritative.
Region directory identities use the full SHA-256 of the logical region name; adding an earlier-sorting region cannot retarget an existing path.
The v3 manifest binds each nested HybridMemory CURRENT hash and the records hash, while the root CURRENT binds the global generation and manifest hash.
Migration from v1/v2 first publishes generation=legacy, builds v3 without changing authority, then performs one atomic switch. Legacy bytes remain for readers already engaged before the switch.
If CURRENT is lost after any v3 global generation exists, reopen, save and pruning fail closed rather than republishing legacy.
Global pruning retains the published generation; a legacy-target CURRENT continues to use per-shard pruning.
LoadLimits.max_file_bytes bounds global manifest resolution, and the MCP consumer validates any non-empty store rather than assuming a root manifest.
